subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The remaining choice changes persisted session recovery semantics and an internal tool/security boundary, so automation should not silently approve it even though the patch is coherent and proven.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun or clear `check-lint`, and merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change the terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored state for aborted delivery-only announce turns, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader model
options.body: If maintainers want one recovery model for all inter-session delivery turns, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun or clear `check-lint`, and merge this PR as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn commits make this the closest available owner for the session-state/tool-boundary merge choice.
